name: Kung pao chicken with rice
steps: Dice the chicken breast and toss with a splash of the soy sauce.
Heat the oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken until golden.
Add the red pepper and spring onions and fry 2 minutes.
Stir in the rest of the soy sauce and the peanuts and toss to coat.
Warm the rice and spoon the kung pao over the top.
